text:
Jon (Support): Escalation: Sparksail trial tenant sparksail-3 can't finish provisioning; sporadic 502s and quota 429s. Customers blocked from adding seats. Escalating to CS for priority comms.
Maya (CS Lead): Acknowledged. Any quick workaround?
Jon (Support): Did key rotate & retry; short-term key helped a few calls only. Logs show provision queue spike. Tagging infra.
Priya (Solutions Eng): We can route provisioning requests to fallback pool for the tenant as a temporary unblock. Internal command: curl -X POST /internal/reroute -d '{"tenant":"sparksail-3","pool":"fallback-provision","expires_in":10800}'
Jon (Support): Infra approved. I can apply the reroute.
Eli (CSM): Recommend sending a 10m acknowledgement email + offer a short call within 45m. This account has expansion signals; want to avoid churn. Also suggest offering a trial credit if activation is materially delayed.
alert-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-2033 (P2). Runbook: internal/playbooks/provisioning-backlog.md
Maya (CS Lead): Approve reroute. Eli, draft comms: apology, what we're doing (fallback routing + ETA), call invite option, postmortem & credit offer. Keep timeline: 10m ack, 45m call, update at 3h.
Jon (Support): Applying reroute now; will post status in 1m.
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll add an automatic expiry and monitor KV usage.
Jon (Support): Reroute applied, API returned 200. Monitoring shows provisioning resumed at reduced throughput.
Eli (CSM): Customer replied: "Thanks — can add first user now." Sent calendar invite.
Maya (CS Lead): Great. Assigning owners: Eli = comms & call, Jon = reroute & monitoring, Priya = SE monitoring, Maya = postmortem & renewal touch.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Metrics look stable; queue draining. Will prepare rollback steps once infra confirms fix.
Eli (CSM): Adding short onboarding note to playbook about this mitigation and the reroute command.
Maya (CS Lead): Closing thread once incident resolved and postmortem posted. Thanks team.
